chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbdullāh ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Aṣamm, from al-Haytham ibn Wāqid, from Muqarrin, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib was the first one who affirmed al-Badāʾ. He will be resurrected on the Day of Judgment as a community by himself; upon him will be the splendor of kings and the mark of the Prophets.

key_terms.أُمَّةً وَحْدَهُ: as a community by himself, indicating singular distinction
key_terms.الْبَدَاءِ: al-Badāʾ, the manifestation of a divine determination in a newly apparent way
key_terms.بَهَاءُ الْمُلُوكِ: the splendor or majesty of kings
key_terms.سِيمَاءُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the distinguishing mark or appearance of the Prophets
key_terms.عَبْدَ الْمُطَّلِبِ: ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, the grandfather of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Resurrection and final reckoning

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib’s belief in al-Badāʾ and his status on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib an early affirmation of al-Badāʾ and describes his exceptional rank on the Day of Resurrection. It presents him as a singular figure, resurrected alone as an entire community, bearing royal splendor and prophetic marks.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asamma, from Al Haysam Bin Waqid, from Muqarran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abdul Muttalibas was the first one who said (believed) in Al-Bada’a (Change of Allahazwj’s Decision). Heasws would be Resurrected on the Day of Judgment as one community. Upon himsaww would be the majesty of the kings and a mark of the Prophetsas’.
en.sarwar: 23. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-’Asamm from al-Hatham ibn Waqid from Muqarrin from abu ‘‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following. “

‘Abd al-Muttalib is the first one who believer in Bada’ (Allah’s revised will). He will be resurrected as a whole nation. He will have a august presence like kings and an countenance like the prophets.”
